_comment: The Awaken ending's cinematic (AW-277). Read by the game (src/ui/Cinematic.tsx) and by tools/audio/narrate.py --script, which renders public/assets/ending-awaken/vo-<id>.ogg. Same format as ending-return.json: a scene's "voice" overrides the narrator's, "speaker" labels the caption, "say" is what's spoken when it differs from the caption, and "chord" is the music's chord (MIDI notes, low to high).
title: AWAKEN

scenes.text: Nobody aboard said what they were all thinking. Ahead, the stars ended in a straight line, like the edge of a page.

scenes.speaker: Navigation
scenes.text: Scanner's returning nothing past the line, Captain. Not dark. Nothing. Like it was never drawn.

scenes.speaker: The eldest listener
scenes.text: Thirty years we listened for this seam. Go gently, Captain. And when you wake, wake the rest of us.
There was no impact. The hull, the cabin, the hum of the drive went out the way a room goes out when you close your eyes.
Cold. Glass, frosted from the inside. A hiss of gas, and a lid that lifts.
Above you, a status panel blinks in an old typeface: ISS INTREPID · CRYOSTASIS · VOYAGE YEAR 2,686 OF 3,900.
scenes.say: Above you, a status panel blinks in an old typeface. Intrepid. Cryostasis. Voyage year two thousand, six hundred and eighty six, of three thousand, nine hundred.

scenes.text: The pods stretch away down the deck in their thousands, every face inside asleep and dreaming. Somewhere among them is your crew.
Beyond the viewport, the stars are the right ones: the ones on the old charts.
The panel blinks again: SESSION ENDED. RESUME?
scenes.say: The panel blinks again. Session ended. Resume?

scenes.text: You could go back to sleep. Or you could start waking the others.
